summary.plain: A 185-kilogram array of sodium-iodide crystals used to measure background rates and study how neutrinos interact with iodine, a step toward a much larger planned sodium-iodide detector.
summary.technical: NaIvE-185: 185 kg array of NaI[Tl] scintillator crystals installed in Neutrino Alley at the SNS in June 2016, used for charged-current neutrino interaction studies on 127-I and CEvNS background characterization ahead of a planned ton-scale expansion.
